title: A Cat in a Cap
lines: Pam did nap on a cot.
A tan cap sat on the cot.
A cat did sit in the cap.
The cat is fat. The cap is not.
Pam did sit. Pam is mad!
It is a cap, cat! Not a cot!
Pop! The cat did tip on the mat.
Pam is not mad. Pam can pat it.

questions.ask: Where did the cat try to sit?
questions.listenFor: In the cap. It is stated in the story. If your child guesses, have them find the line with the word cap and read it again.

questions.ask: Why could the cat not stay in the cap?
questions.listenFor: The cat is fat and the cap is small, so the cat did not fit. Listen for the idea of size, not just "it fell."

questions.ask: What do you think Pam should do with her cap now? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine - wash it, share it, give it to the cat. You are listening for a reason, and a reason that comes from the story is even better.
